ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio; predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels with highly concentrated high-intensity (white) pixels localized at distal extremities.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white blobs located at the extreme left and right distal tips. Low-density white mottling and speckling distributed sparsely across the central black surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped central depression with an estimated obtuse angle between 140 and 150 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-amplitude undulating boundary across the horizontal span; serrations become more irregular and higher in frequency toward the distal margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curvature along the posterior trailing edge of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed, roughly circular high-contrast pixel clusters (white) indicative of barnacle colonies on the lateral-most edges of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization present on the distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
